main_text.p: תקע Chal. Figere, infigere, affigere, ut clavum aut paxillum: Clangere tuba, sono fixo & aequabili: Plaudere, Complodere, manu manui infigere cū sonitu, Psal.47.2. Ithpehal אתתקע Clangi, Jesa.27.13. תקיעותא Ch. Clangor, Psal.150.3.

תקף Ch. & Syr. Valuit, invaluit, praevaluit, fortis, valens, robustus, potens, gravis fuit, roboratus, confirmatus, induratus, obduratus fuit: Confirmavit, active, 1.Sam.23.16. Commotus, offensus, iratus fuit, arsit, exarsit ira, ira accensus fuit: Instititit, Gen.19.3. Pahel תקף Firmavit, confirmavit, obfirmavit, obduravit, fortificavit, roboravit, corroboravit, restauravit: Item Iratus fuit, Psalm.60.3. Destruxit, Psal.80.13. Aphel אתקיף Idem: & intransitive, Confirmavit se, 1.Sam.30.6. Item Vim inferre, Retinere, sc.vi, Detinere, prehendere, apprehendere, comprehendere; Instare, urgere, Gen.19.9. Judic.19.7. Ithpehal אתתקף Firmum, Fortem se exhibuit, fortificavit, confirmavit se, confirmatus, corroboratus, obfirmatus, obduratus, induratus fuit. Ithpah. אתקף Idem. Verbum est usitatissimum, & latissimae significationis apud Chaldaeos.
תקיפא תקיף Ch. Potens, valens, validus, fortis, firmus, robustus, vehemens. Plural. תקיפין: Syr.
תוקפא תוקף Ch. & Syr. Firmitas, robur, fortitudo, potentia, gravitas, vehementia: Vehementia animi, ira, furor, excandescentia: Arx, munitio, Jud.6.26. Jesa.23.11. בתוקפא Cum vehementia, vehementer,

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are printed in Hebrew/Syriac letters; the transcription of the vocalised Hebrew headwords and the Syriac line is approximate. Lines of the Syriac entry near "Potentes" are damaged and uncertain.
